game_concept: A action puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Broken Colonnade, a row of broken columns: the relic hunter must handle ghost knights while practicing lists. Core idea – Index Archery: Hit targets by choosing the right list index, including negative ones.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Broken Colonnade: a row of broken columns
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Declare float: declare resource as float, apply resource + 7.5, and print each result with %.1f. Dataset 7 starts with [-3, 0, 15, 18]. Match every stream. Use a full main function and a return statement.
controls: Edit the C program. Run tests all streams; Step shows declarations, assignments and output. readInput() is a LogiCade game-port helper declared in logicade.h. This safe practice runtime supports a documented C subset.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Index Archery' (Week 7 slot 2), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Broken Colonnade'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Basic Parts of C and Variable Declarations

region.name: Eldritch Ruins

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.

source_player_objective: Collect 340 points of glyph tablets by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
source_lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 340, or lives reach 0.
hint: Declare before use. float resource = readInput(); creates the named game-port value; printf uses %.1f.
